name: Hafiz Muhammad Saeed
real_life_parallel: LeT founder; 26/11 mastermind; jailed 2020 but operationally relevant; FATF pressure

biography.background: Founder of Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT) and Jamaat-ud-Dawa (JuD). Mastermind of 26/11 Mumbai attacks (2008). UN-designated terrorist. Jailed February 2020 on terror financing charges (FATF pressure) but operational control continued through proxies.
biography.26_11_role: Chief planner; operational oversight; ISI coordination through Sajid Mir
biography.proxy_rebranding: TRF (The Resistance Front) as LeT proxy for plausible deniability
biography.son: Hafiz Talha Saeed — designated terrorist 2025; successor planning
biography.film_relevance: Part 1: 26/11 architect. Part 4: Sindoor target (Muridke Markaz); proxy operations through TRF.
